description: One applied change to a lane surface, with the monotonic Sequence the shared live contract needs. The shape is deliberately concrete rather than generic: TmAgentLanes applies these events to the snapshot it renders through AgentEventStream<TEvent>, so a host only has to build one small record per change regardless of its transport (a SignalR hub, a one-second poll, a server-sent event stream). A batch may arrive more than once — the stream drops what was already applied — so the host never de-duplicates itself. The payload of the kind decides what happens: BlockUpserted carries Block, BlockRemoved carries BlockId, HandoffAdded carries Handoff; a missing payload makes the event a no-op instead of an error.

members.name: Sequence
members.description: The event's position in the run's change log; it must grow by ONE per applied change, because the shared stream treats "the last applied sequence plus one" as its definition of contiguity and rejects a batch with a hole rather than papering over it.

members.name: Kind
members.description: What the event does. Default BlockUpserted.

members.name: Block
members.description: The block an upsert carries. Null makes BlockUpserted a no-op.

members.name: BlockId
members.description: The id a removal addresses. Null makes BlockRemoved a no-op; an id no block carries is a no-op too.

members.name: Handoff
members.description: The link a handoff adds. Null makes HandoffAdded a no-op; the same link delivered twice is recorded once.
